reasoning_input.question_text: Find the Taylor series expansion of f(x) = cos(x) in powers of (x - π/3) up to and including the term in (x - π/3)³.

student_steps.content: Taylor series formula: f(x) = f(a) + f'(a)(x - a) + f''(a)(x - a)²/2! + f'''(a)(x - a)³/3! + ... with a = π/3

steps.description: State Taylor series expansion formula centered at a = π/3
Divide by factorials to obtain 1/2 - (√3/2)(x - π/3) - (1/4)(x - π/3)² + (√3/12)(x - π/3)³
